treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Hungary and the Government of the State of Israel for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1991)
eif_quote: (Az Egyezmény megerősítéséről szóló jegyzékváltás 1992. szeptember 14-én megtörtént. Ennek megfelelően az Egyezmény 1992. november 13-án hatályba lépett.) — 1993. évi LXIII. törvény 1. §; NAV list: Israel | 1991. V. 14. | Act LXIII of 1993 | 1993. I. 1.
source_title: Hungarian Ministry of Finance – Synthesised text of the MLI and the Hungary–Israel Convention (English); cross-checked with Act LXIII of 1993 (net.jogtar.hu)

rates.quote: (a) 5% of the gross amount of the dividends if the recipient holds directly at least 10% of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 15% of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State, if such resident is the beneficial recipient of the interest.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the royalties

ppt.basis: MLI art. 7(1) (replaces treaty Art. 25 Limitation of Benefits)
ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude

notes: Dividend 5% tier: recipient (not limited to companies) holding directly >=10% of capital; no MLI Art. 8 holding period shown in the synthesised text. Interest and royalties taxable only in the residence State (0% at source). Royalty definition includes computer programs and equipment rental. MLI: effect in Hungary for WHT on/after 1 January 2022; in Israel from the first day of the taxable period beginning on/after 1 July 2021 (=1 January 2022). MLI Art. 7(1) PPT replaces treaty Art. 25. Art. 29(2)(a): WHT from 1 January of the year following EIF; Act LXIII of 1993 s. 3 applies it to income arising on/after 1 January 1993. Hungarian promulgation text (net.jogtar.hu, non-governmental host of the official act) matches the rates.
